# Facebook Reels Scraper

The Apify actor [`apify/facebook-reels-scraper`](https://apify.com/apify/facebook-reels-scraper) as typed Telo kinds, generated from its build **0.0.319**. The module's version is that build number, and every run it starts is pinned to exactly that build, so the input types below are the ones the actor really runs with.

Extract data from hundreds of Facebook reels from one or multiple Facebook pages and profiles. Get reel URL, text, page or profile URL, timestamp, number of plays and more. Download the data in JSON, CSV, and Excel and use it in apps, spreadsheets, and reports.

## Pricing

Pay per event — Reel $0.005 (Free-plan prices; paid plans pay less). Cap the spend with `maxTotalChargeUsd`.

Runs are charged to the Apify account whose token the `ApifyClient` holds. See the [Store page](https://apify.com/apify/facebook-reels-scraper) for current prices.

## Import

```yaml
imports:
  Actor: oci://ghcr.io/telorun/apify/apify-facebook-reels-scraper@0.0.319#sha256-…
```

Pin the digest with `telo upgrade`. The module re-exports `ApifyClient`, so it is the only import needed.

## Usage

```yaml
kind: Actor.ApifyClient
metadata: { name: apify }
token: !cel "secrets.apifyToken"
---
kind: Actor.Run          # or Actor.Start for runs longer than 5 minutes
metadata: { name: scrape }
client: !ref apify
maxTotalChargeUsd: 1     # optional: timeout, memory, maxItems, maxTotalChargeUsd
---
kind: Run.Sequence
metadata: { name: main }
steps:
  - name: scrape
    invoke: !ref scrape
    inputs:
      startUrls: []
```

- **`Run`** calls Apify's synchronous endpoint and returns `{ items }`. Apify holds the request open for at most 300 seconds; a longer run fails with HTTP 408.
- **`Start`** starts the run, long-polls it until it finishes, and returns `{ run, items }`. A run that ends `FAILED`, `TIMED-OUT` or `ABORTED` raises `APIFY_RUN_NOT_SUCCEEDED` with the run as `data`.

## Input

Only these fields are accepted — `telo check` rejects any other.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `startUrls` | array | yes |  | Facebook URLs — Enter a Facebook page URL to scrape its reels, e.g. https://www.facebook.com/LeonardoDiCaprio/, or a direct reel URL to scrape one reel, e.g. https://www.facebook.com/reel/1350782990582563/. |
| `resultsLimit` | integer |  |  | Results amount — If this limit is not set as many results as possible are returned |
| `onlyPostsNewerThan` | string |  |  | Reels newer than — Scrape reels from the provided date to the present day. The date should be in YYYY-MM-DD or full ISO absolute format or in relative format e.g. 1 days, 2 months, 3 years. The JSON input also supports adding time units (UTC timezone): Full or partial ISO timestamp (e.g., `2025-09-2 |
